what_this_is: The deterministic gate. No model calls, no secrets, runs in seconds on everything. It decides only what is decidable without judgement. Run it before any model call: spending a draft-gate token on an em dash is waste.

canon_exemption.why: A canon document names retired brands in order to forbid them. A gate that blocks its own rulebook does not survive contact with a deadline.
